headword: {白羽|しらは}の{矢|や}が{立|た}つ
gloss: to be singled out (for a task or role)

definitions.gloss: to be singled out (for a task or role)
definitions.explanation: To be the one chosen out of many for a task, post or role. Today it is usually neutral or positive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白羽|しらは}の{矢|や}が{立|た}った。
examples.english: He was the one singled out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白羽|しらは}の{矢|や}が{立|た}った。
examples.english: Yamada was chosen as the new leader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧{白羽|しらは}の{矢|や}が{立|た}った⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I still don't know why I, with so little experience, was the one picked.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From a legend in which a god demanding a maiden as a sacrifice shot a white-feathered arrow into the roof of the chosen girl's house.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白羽|しらは}の{矢|や}が{立|た}つ: X is singled out
- X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白羽|しらは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{矢|や}→矢：10461_ya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to single out X

WATCH OUT:
{白羽|しらは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{矢|や}→矢：10461_ya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ is a common slip; the standard form is ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧.
